name: git-proxy-api
description: Git Proxy API — Authelia-fronted read path to GitHub so the phone holds NO GitHub credential (#647, route 3 of #646's fallback chain). The caller authenticates to US with the Authelia bearer it already has; this service holds the GitHub token server-side and streams the result back.

native_build._cmd_doc: There are NO npm dependencies — the service is stdlib-only ESM on node:22 (http + WebCrypto for the JWKS/RS256 verify). RUN is unconditional in the image-wrapper generator, so it is spent on a syntax check of our own entrypoint: a parse error fails the BUILD instead of crash-looping a deployed container. Nothing outside this service's own source can fail its release (#254).
native_build.cmd: node --check index.mjs && node --check authz.mjs && node --check upstream.mjs && node --check contract.mjs
native_build._apt_doc: ca-certificates only, and it is load-bearing: both outbound dependencies are HTTPS (auth.diegonmarcos.com/jwks.json for the bearer verify, api.github.com for the work). A missing trust store would not fail the build — it would 502 every request in production. No curl: the healthcheck probes with node.

deploy._compose_flags_doc: --no-build, NOT the --build that most siblings declare. oci-analytics has 954MB of RAM and the host's docker wrapper (/home/ubuntu/.local/bin/docker, first on the non-interactive SSH PATH the ship uses) hard-refuses `compose --build` under 2GB: 'BLOCKED: docker compose --build on a small VM (954MB < 2GB)', exit 1. That is what failed run 36565748851 — files and .secrets landed, the GHCR image was public and pullable, and no container was ever created. --no-build is also simply correct here: the image is built on the GHA runner and pushed to GHCR, so it must never be rebuilt on the target.
deploy._host_doc: oci-analytics, NOT oci-apps, for two reasons. (1) It is the public-edge VM that already terminates api.diegonmarcos.com/pub (c3-public-api), so the phone reaches /git OFF-MESH — which is the whole point of route 3 versus the `gh` fallback. (2) An oci-apps ship recreates my-ai_claude-api and kills every running agent; this service has no reason to go there.

proxy._doc: auth=two_factor is what the deriver turns into the Caddy mkProtected block: `@bearer header Authorization Bearer*` -> forward_auth 10.0.0.1:4182 /auth (infra-sec_introspect-proxy), with the interactive Authelia session as the non-bearer fallback. That is exactly the credential the phone ALREADY holds (cloud-u-android ab_cloud-libs-shared/build.json auth.sign_in.providers[id=authelia], kind=authelia_bearer, scope authelia.bearer.authz) — no new OIDC client, no new grant. Only /git/health is pre-auth, via the engine-supported public_paths[] array, so #646's chain has an unauthenticated reachability probe.

resources._doc: A tarball is streamed, never buffered, so memory does not scale with repository size. 128M is headroom for node's baseline plus the JWKS cache.

runtime._doc: THE endpoint contract, declared once, here. The image-wrapper generator COPYs build.json to /app/build.json, so code/contract.mjs reads this exact block at runtime and GET /git/endpoints serves it verbatim — there is no second copy to drift from. #646's client asserts against that response instead of hardcoding paths, which is the drift #371 was (client dialling 10.0.0.4 while the service deployed to 10.0.0.6).

endpoints.description: Liveness. The only pre-auth route. Returns {"status":"ok","service":"git-proxy-api"} and nothing about GitHub — an unreachable service must look unreachable, never like a 200 with an error body (#568).
This contract, verbatim from build.json runtime. Machine-readable so a client can assert its own call list against ours.

The repos the server-side GitHub credential can see. Returns {repos:[{full_name,owner,name,private,default_branch,updated_at,size_kb}]} — a projection, never the upstream body, so no upstream field can carry a credential through.

Streamed gzip tarball of :ref (query `ref`, default the repo's default branch). Proxied straight from GitHub's codeload redirect to the caller — nothing is written to disk, which is deliberate: oci disks have sat at 87-97% and an unscoped prune has destroyed services twice (#353/#393).

upstream._token_doc: GITHUB_TOKEN arrives ONLY as a sops-decrypted env_file value (src/secrets.yaml -> dist/.secrets -> compose env_file). It is read once at startup, used ONLY in upstream.mjs#upstreamHeaders as an outbound Authorization header, and every response body this service emits is passed through redactSecrets() first. code/test-contract-and-authz.mjs mutation-proves both halves.

authelia._doc: Same three values infra-sec_introspect-proxy validates on, so a token minted for ANY existing Authelia client (cli, cloud-admin, claude-*) works here unchanged. Verified in-service as well as at the Caddy edge: the edge gate does not exist when the service is dialled directly over the mesh, and the tester has to be able to assert a refusal.

api.description: Authelia-fronted read path to GitHub: list repos and stream a tarball. The GitHub credential stays server-side; the caller only ever presents an Authelia bearer.
